title: Diamond OA Policy Forum Europe: Strategies for Funding Diamond OA in Europe
organization: ALMASI project; contributors from Slovenia, ANR, TU Delft, Université de Lorraine, TIB and SCOSS
what_changed: The collection places six funding approaches side by side: Slovenian national policy, the French ANR perspective, a university-library model, the AEGIS-OA protection project, TIB's German KOALA consortial-financing service, and SCOSS's international coordination model.
why_it_matters: These materials expose the institutional choices hidden inside the generic injunction to "fund Diamond OA": direct public subsidy, library portfolio funding, consortial pledging, risk pooling, or internationally coordinated support. The KOALA case is especially useful for Germany because it translates dispersed library budgets into multi-year collective financing.
